messages.text: The first differential run exposed infrastructure and logic mismatches rather than uncertainty: Rust emits raw LF bytes on Windows, Python text streams translated them to CRLF and used the console code page for tree glyphs; the tree root was also rendered twice, and recursive traversal was breadth-first instead of eza’s depth-first section order. I’m correcting output at the byte boundary and those traversal invariants first, then rerunning the same matrix so the remaining failures isolate actual formatting behavior.
